questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Jim will translate it.

options.text: It will be translate by Jim.
It will be translated by Jim.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**It will be translated by Jim**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passive voice construction for future tense sentences typically starts with the subject followed by "**will be**" and the past participle of the verb.
 
• In the sentence "**Jim will translate** **it**," the object "**it**" becomes the subject in the passive voice.
 
• The verb "**translate**" in its past participle form is "**translated**."
 
• "**By Jim**" is added at the end to specify the agent performing the action.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is '**It will be translated by Jim**'.

​Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **It will be translate by Jim.**

 
 
• This option is incorrect because "translate" is not in its past participle form. The correct form should be "translated."
 
 
 
• **It would translate by Jim.**
 
 
• This option is incorrect because "would" indicates a conditional or hypothetical situation, not a future action. Also, "translate" needs to be in its past participle form "translated."
 
 
 
• **It is translated by Jim.**
 
 
• This option is incorrect because it uses present tense "is translated," while the original sentence is in the future tense "will translate."

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in active voice.

About 200 birds were driven out of their habitats by the City Council based on a Health Department recommendation.

options.text: A Health Department recommendation was the basis for the City Council to drive out 200 birds from their habitats.
The City Council drove about 200 birds out of their habitats, based on a Health Department recommendation.
About 200 birds is driven out of their habitats based on a Health Department recommendation.
The City Council has driven about 200 birds out of their habitats based on a Health Department recommendation.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**The City Council drove about 200 birds out of their habitats, based on a Health Department recommendation**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The active voice converts the subject performing the action (here, the City Council) to the subject of the sentence.
 
• The original passive voice sentence indicates the action performed on the birds by the City Council.
 
• The structure should align with the past tense used in the original passive sentence ("**were driven**").
 
• "**About 200 birds**" becomes the object in the active voice sentence.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is '**The City Council drove about 200 birds out of their habitats, based on a Health Department recommendation**'.

​Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A Health Department recommendation was the basis for the City Council to drive out 200 birds from their habitats.**

 
 
• This option is incorrect because, although it provides context, it does not present the sentence in the active voice form directly mentioning the subject (City Council) performing the action.
 
 
 
• **About 200 birds is driven out of their habitats based on a Health Department recommendation.**
 
 
• This option is incorrect because "is driven" is incorrectly used instead of the past tense form and it does not successfully convert the sentence to the active voice.
 
 
 
• **The City Council has driven about 200 birds out of their habitats based on a Health Department recommendation.**
 
 
• This option is incorrect because it uses present perfect tense ("has driven") instead of the past tense used in the original sentence.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

I said to Amit, "I am not participating in the annual function."

options.text: I said Amit that I was not participating in the annual function.
I told Amit that he was not participating in the annual function.
I told Amit that I was not participating in the annual function.
I told to Amit that I was not participating in the annual function.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** '**I told Amit that I was not participating in the annual function'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• This sentence requires converting direct speech into indirect speech.
 
• The structure of indirect speech for an assertive sentence includes using '**that**' to connect the reporting speech and reported speech.
 
• When converting to indirect speech, the first-person pronoun '**I**' in the direct speech changes according to the subject of the reporting verb, which remains '**I**' in this context.
 
• The verb tense in the reported speech changes from present continuous '**am participating**' to past continuous '**was participating**'.
 
• **Option 3** is the correct transformation from direct to indirect speech for the given sentence.
 
 
• **Example:** Direct: He said, "I am going to the market." Indirect: He said that he was going to the market.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *I told Amit that I was not participating in the annual function*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) *I said Amit that I was not participating in the annual function.***

 
 
• The sentence incorrectly uses "said" without "to" before "Amit." The correct form should be "told Amit" or "said to Amit." Hence, the sentence structure is incorrect.
 
 
 
• **Option 2) *I told Amit that he was not participating in the annual function.***
 
 
• The pronoun "he" replaces "I," which changes the meaning of the sentence. The original statement is about "I" not participating, but this option incorrectly suggests Amit is not participating.
 
 
 
• **Option 4) *I told to Amit that I was not participating in the annual function.***
 
 
• The phrase "told to Amit" is incorrect. "Told" should directly precede the indirect object without "to," making the correct form "told Amit." Thus, the sentence contains a grammatical error.

The imposition of lock down proved to be a _________ for many students who were not prepared for the examinations.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **'blessing in disguise'**.

• **Example: **Losing that job was a **blessing in disguise** because it pushed me to start my own business.
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, the lockdown initially appears to be a hindrance.
 
• For students who were not prepared for their examinations, it turned out to be beneficial.
 
• The lockdown may have given them extra time to study.
 
• This makes "**blessing in disguise**" the most appropriate choice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

**Complete Sentence:** *The imposition of lock down proved to be a blessing in disguise__ for many students who were not prepared for the examinations.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question: How would e-transactions help the Government of India?

options.text: Increasing the audit work at government level

Increasing the cash transportation charges at government level

questions.solution:

• The ability to audit electronic transactions is a significant advantage for regulatory and enforcement bodies, helping to reduce the incidence of black money.
 
• The main goal of promoting e-transactions is to move away from cash, which is harder to track and often used in illegal activities.

• **Increasing the cash transportation charges at government level:**
 
 
• The passage highlights a reduction in costs associated with printing, distributing, and maintaining cash, thus reducing overall cash-related expenses.
